entries.not_relevant_because: The only manuscript, 'A Torsion-Free Group Algebra with Zero Divisors', constructs a finitely presented torsion-free group G with nonzero zero divisors in F₂[G], disproving Kaplansky's zero-divisor conjecture. It says nothing about surjunctivity, cellular automata, injective G-equivariant self-maps of full shifts, or Gottschalk's formulation; a text search of the paper and all of its \input sections finds no such term. Group algebras and torsion-freeness are shared vocabulary, but the claim does not bear on whether every group is surjunctive.
